purpose: Requirements for the information a ToC manages, change detection against an existing ToC, and ToC build, update and commit, including field limits and acceptance conditions.
summary: Information requirements for document info, section entries, and reference entries in the ToC
Limits for AI generated fields: description limit L and internal tolerance limit H, kept separate
Change detection against the committed ToC: new, body change, reference change, move, departure, unchanged
Content hash definition: SHA-256 of raw text excluding the formal reference title
Timing of updating the reflected hash on ToC commit
ToC build and rebuild order: confirm IDs, detect changes, fetch information and update
Generation of document info with reuse of existing fields when the hash is unchanged
Reference relation extraction and reconstruction with directory-based check states
ToC candidate validation and atomic commit, keeping the last committed ToC on failure
tasks: Designing or implementing ToC build and rebuild
Implementing change detection and the change set
Implementing hash calculation for documents and sections
Implementing AI generated field generation and limit validation
Writing tests for ToC acceptance conditions
Reviewing ToC data model and logical fields
title: doc-link 要件定義書 — [ToC]管理
